title: Crestline Fleet Account Remittance, Dispute Window and Credit Memo Settings
content:
These program settings govern how money comes in on a Crestline Fleet Account and how invoices are corrected. Amounts are in USD.

## Payment methods and remittance advice

| Program | Ways the business may pay | Remittance must name the invoice numbers it pays to be applied to them |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Fleet Starter | ACH; check; card on file | no |
| Crestline Fleet Business | ACH; check; card on file | no |
| Crestline Fleet Commercial | ACH; check; wire | yes |
| Crestline Fleet National | ACH; check; wire | yes |
| Crestline Fleet Enterprise | ACH; wire | yes |
| Crestline Fleet Public Sector | ACH; check; wire; government purchase card | yes |

On every program a remittance that names no invoice is applied oldest invoice first, and when a remittance pays less than an invoice the unpaid difference remains open on that invoice.

## Disputes and credit memos

| Program | Dispute window (calendar days after the invoice date) | Largest credit memo customer care may issue on one invoice |
|---|---|---|
| Crestline Fleet Starter | 30 | 100.00 |
| Crestline Fleet Business | 30 | 150.00 |
| Crestline Fleet Commercial | 45 | 250.00 |
| Crestline Fleet National | 45 | 500.00 |
| Crestline Fleet Enterprise | 60 | 1000.00 |
| Crestline Fleet Public Sector | 60 | 250.00 |

Credits larger than the desk limit go to Crestline Fleet Credit.

## Duplicate invoices

On every program two invoices are duplicates when they match on all four of: the vehicle, the invoice date, the service category and the amount.

## Duplicate test (hypothetical invoices)

| Second invoice compared with the first | Duplicate? |
|---|---|
| same vehicle, same date, same service category, same amount | yes |
| same vehicle, same date, same amount, different service category | no |
| same vehicle, same service category, same amount, different date | no |
